incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert: service=api-inference latency.p99 > 1200ms for 5m. Pager: p99-latency-autopage, link: https://pagerduty.example/PD12345
Alice K: Acked. I'm on it, switching to incident channel.
Ben S: grabbing traces/quick perf. can someone check KV-cache eviction rates?
Clara R: I see a spike in KV miss ratio from 0.02 -> 0.47 at 17:02 UTC. Likely coldstarts on the pool.
Evan (oncall): Confirmed high ✋. Traffic not routing to fallback models due to a routing key mismatch. Attempting manual route flip.
Alice K: Steps: 1) reroute 20% to rg-fallback-2, 2) warm KV prefixes, 3) scale up dedicated pool. Runbook: /runbook latency_kv_warm (see step 2).
Ben S: logs from gpu-serve-3: ```ERROR kv_cache: miss for prefix user:session:12345
2024-03-12T17:01:55Z model_load: initiating lazy-init``` Looks like lazy model loads are firing.
Evan (oncall): Running: `curl -s -XPOST https://console.internal/reload?pool=rg-primary&force=true` to nudge warmers. Pushing 10 warm requests to hot prefixes.
Clara R: Flipping routing policy now: `routing update --route api-inference --policy split --weights primary:80,fallback:20` — sending confirmation.
incident-bot: PagerDuty: PD alert PD12345 status=acknowledged by Alice K at 1743219999. Next escalation at 1743220799 if unresolved.
Alice K: After flip, p99 dropped from 1300ms -> 820ms for 2m. Still noisy, keeping scale plan. :thumbsup:
Ben S: Starting scale action: `k8s scale deployment gpu-pool-primary --replicas=12` (was 8). Watching queue length.
Evan (oncall): Observability: queue depth down 30%, CPU on warmers up 15%. KV miss ratio trending down to 0.12.
Clara R: Customer impact check: only 0.6% of requests saw >1.2s and none from known 3rd-party enterprise tenants. Flagging limited impact.
Alice K: Notifying support/ops channel and updating status page: "Degraded latency for small subset; mitigation in progress."
PagerDuty: Notification sent to escalation policy leads.
Ben S: After scale & warm, p99 stabilized ~680ms for last 3m. Continuing to monitor 10m window.
Evan (oncall): I'll keep the route split for 15m, then progressively move back to primary if stable. Preparing postmortem notes: suspected root cause: simultaneous lazy-load churn + autoscaler lag + routing key misconfig.
Alice K: Agreed. Action items: (1) add proactive KV-warm for cold prefixes on deployment, (2) tighten autoscaler target to reduce lag, (3) add route-e2e check in rollout pipeline.
Clara R: I'll file the follow-up ticket and assign owners. Ticket: INF-4521.
incident-bot: Closing note: incident marked resolved at 1743220405 after p99 recovery and route validated. :white_check_mark:
